name: MediaPipe GitHub repository (Google on-device ML)
notes: README: 'MediaPipe contains everything that you need to customize and deploy to mobile (Android, iOS), web, desktop, edge devices, and IoT, effortlessly.' Two documented notices: (1) primary developer documentation moved to developers.google.com/mediapipe as of 2023-04-03, with the GitHub README as secondary; (2) 'MediaPipe Solutions Preview is an early release'. Solution categories explicitly cover VISION (object detector), TEXT (text classifier) and AUDIO (audio classifier) tasks, with setup guides for Android, web apps and Python. Topics include android, graph-based, graph-framework, inference, live/streaming (stream-processing, video-processing, audio-processing). Self-described as 'cross-platform, customizable ML solutions for live and streaming media'. API metadata 2026-10-04: created 2019-06-13, last push 2026-10-04 (same day), 37162 stars, 6183 forks, 430 open issues, not archived, Apache-2.0, C++ primary language.
